$comment: Single source of truth for labels used by BOTH the CoreML (Python) and gliner25-rs (Rust) runs. The CoreML extraction bucket allows <= 8 entity queries and the relation head <= 4 relation types (R4). `label` is the natural-language prompt sent to GLiNER; `ontonotes` is the OntoNotes 5.0 tag it maps back to. Descriptions are from the OntoNotes 5.0 release notes; whether to send them to the model is an experiment knob (they cost prompt tokens against the 128-token bucket).
